sectionDescription: Dr. Chatha provides expert care across a range of pediatric conditions, ensuring every child receives accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.

items.title: Infectious Diseases
items.description: Diagnosis and treatment of viral, bacterial, and fungal infections in children, including fever management and preventive care.

items.title: Allergies & Asthma
items.description: Comprehensive management of allergic reactions, asthma, and immune-related conditions to help children breathe and live comfortably.

items.title: Digestive System Conditions
items.description: Expert care for pediatric digestive disorders including Crohn's disease, celiac disease, and other gastrointestinal conditions.
